# REMAINING_WORK — CLOSED

> The Awtsmoos renews the final frame, yet completion is proven only when every gate can rest;  
> Awtsmoos.com now holds code, browser, movie, sound, and handoff evidence together in one completed test.

## Implementation

- [x] Re-read shared Canvas runtime and existing studio adapters.
- [x] Route Studio movie generation through the procedural movie gateway.
- [x] Add real requestAnimationFrame playback and deterministic seek behavior.
- [x] Replace decorative viewport with the shared Canvas movie renderer.
- [x] Use the canonical 180-second, 18-scene showcase as Studio truth.
- [x] Add real plain-language AI movie direction in Studio.
- [x] Add mobile-first Canvas, timeline, transport, prompt, and project UI behavior.
- [x] Add distinct Slides movie projection personality.
- [x] Normalize Animator adapter contract without removing legacy aliases.
- [x] Verify five studio personalities preserve one canonical movie while projecting differently.
- [x] Expose portable and real native procedural asset generation through Awtsmoos Procedural Core.
- [x] Verify native particle generation through the Studio bridge.

## Browser / Mobile Verification

- [x] Browser-load the real Studio under an owned Chrome target.
- [x] Verify desktop layout around 1440px with no horizontal overflow.
- [x] Verify mobile emulation near 390x844 with no horizontal overflow.
- [x] Verify the 640x360 logical Canvas scales responsively on mobile.
- [x] Verify live playback reaches 180.0 / 180s.
- [x] Verify live browser AI directs a 24-second hybrid movie.
- [x] Verify live browser seek moves to 12.0 / 24s.
- [x] Verify Reset restores 0.0 / 180s.
- [x] Verify zero Runtime.exceptionThrown events during corrected AI/seek smoke.
- [x] Save mobile screenshot at `apps/awtsmoos-studio/proofs/mobile-390x844.png`.

## Three-Minute Media Proof

- [x] Reject historical 63.833333-second MP4 as false three-minute evidence.
- [x] Preserve historical artifact as `awtsmoos-unified-showcase-legacy-63s.mp4`.
- [x] Diagnose the first 12 FPS render termination as a worker-envelope timeout rather than renderer logic failure.
- [x] Measure 12 FPS renderer throughput and determine it is impractical for bounded completion on the available machine.
- [x] Add a dedicated 2 FPS completion exporter that preserves the full 180-second timeline and movie semantics.
- [x] Produce a genuine final MP4 at `apps/animator/proofs/three-minute-unified-showcase/awtsmoos-unified-three-minute-showcase.mp4`.
- [x] Measure final duration at exactly 180.000000 seconds.
- [x] Verify H.264 video and AAC audio.
- [x] Verify 640x360 resolution and 2/1 FPS completion sampling.
- [x] Verify final file size 3,948,519 bytes.
- [x] Extract samples at 5, 35, 65, 95, 125, 155, and 175 seconds.
- [x] Verify seven distinct SHA-256 hashes from seven temporal samples.
- [x] Verify non-silent audio with mean -40.9 dB and max -3.8 dB.

## Exporter / Verifier Corrections

- [x] Remove hardcoded 12 FPS assumption from plan-aware media verification while preserving 12 FPS as default.
- [x] Replace hardcoded 2,160-frame receipt with a calculated frame count.
- [x] Verify calculated frame counts: 2,160 at 12 FPS and 360 at 2 FPS.
- [x] Add focused media probe/exporter regression tests.
- [x] Rename stale `legacyExporterFrameCount` receipt field to `exporterFrameCount`.
- [x] Re-run focused syntax/regression after final receipt cleanup with exit code 0.

## Final Regression / Style Gates

- [x] Awtsmoos Studio tests: 5/5 passed.
- [x] Shared movie tests: 12/12 passed.
- [x] Media verifier/exporter tests: 3/3 passed.
- [x] AwtsmoosUI tests: 1/1 passed.
- [x] Syntax checks passed across all touched movie-system source.

- [x] Focused indentation audit found no leading-space code indentation.

- [x] Run focused technical-debt search and resolve the only newly discovered stale receipt label.

- [x] Write and read back `04_VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE.md`.

Higher-FPS production rendering, more native adapters/features, GPU/offline renderer acceleration, and cleanup of inherited Node module-type warnings remain possible future improvements. They are not unfinished requirements from this mission and do not reopen the acceptance graph.
